steps.content: [Rooftop]

The shackles are straining to break through the contamination, but they can't harm Bianca at all. She didn't lie about one thing. She is indeed just an ordinary person. Her disaster-causing ability does not belong to a Sinner.
Amid the turbulent Mania, a normal person without any special power is just a twig that will snap in an instant. Bianca's sanity is gradually being shattered, overtaken by the power she so desires.
Yet she's smiling so brightly, opening her arms to joyfully embrace the Mania. It's as if what's rushing toward her isn't a maniacal monster, but the justice she's long awaited.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hahahah! How many people do you think Gray Mirror will backfire on? A hundred? A thousand? An entire district! So many have voted for you. Surely they won't disappoint me!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: It's all thanks to you that Gray Mirror has become the hottest topic in town! Look...
[Go insane CG]

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: How massive it's gotten!

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: Malice... Malice! Feed me more malice!

Contamination has ripped open a gaping rift between virtuality and reality, obscuring the sun and reigning supreme over all, as digitalized Corruptors descend one after another. Amid the chaos, the flow of people in the streets continues as usual, as if completely blind to the terrible disaster.

...No. It's not invisible to all ordinary people, but non-Gray Mirror users. You hear screams everywhere. People are shrieking and fleeing, bodies being gnawed by digitalized contamination and voices severely interfered, finally twisting and shattering under the astonished gazes of the crowd.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: It's the final episode of the anime! The last boss is coming...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Great, here comes the ceremony where I'm to declare the victory of justice! I'm the master of Gray Mirror. I permit it!

The virtual contamination finally condenses into a huge grinning mask. Its hunger makes you tremble. This monster craves malice, and its first meal will be its summoner. It opens its maw and rushes toward Bianca...
You block the monster's first attack, raising your hand to unleash the shackles and repel the giant mask with all your strength. It doesn't buy you much time and anger has taken over you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Done with your monologue? This isn't a power you can wield. Do you have a death wish?! Are you proclaiming your so-called justice with these monsters? What kind of justice is that?
The response is a long, deranged laugh. Bianca shakes uncontrollably as she cackles. Her body is gradually being segmented by digitalized grids, the last bit of rationality faded from her eyes.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Yes, I have no right, and neither do they... Our hands are all dirty. How can we partake in such an important ceremony?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Only you have the right to vote! Come on, Ashy, cast your vote of justice!
Suddenly, she grabs your collar and faces you. The malicious mask is no longer approaching, yet you glimpse the same madness on the girl's face.
...No, it's a trap. Mania has seized you. She leans closer eagerly, in delirium, her every word shakes your nerves.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Everyone who's participated in the vote has committed cyber violence. Can we still call them good people? No, we both know how bad they are.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: So, just tap on here, and everyone who's voted for you before will disappear! Isn't it simple?
The same voice, warm with enthusiasm, has slowed down to gently tempt you into making a choice, but where your palm touches her skin, you feel an abnormal chill.
Distant screams remind you that the disaster is still ongoing, and you must break free from Bianca and subdue this master of Gray Mirror who calls you a partner.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you the Bianca I know, or a puppet controlled by another puppet? Do you really wish to be like the very Gray Mirror fanatics you despise in the guise of justice?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You hate them for erasing others based on their narrow standards, but what about you? Aren't you also judging the Gray Mirror users by your standards and lynching them in the name of justice? How are you different from those you despise?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: As long as it eliminates your perceived evil, you don't care even if you turn into a monster yourself? What does that make you? Do you call this duplicitous, pathetic thing your justice?

The shackles slash through her body. A fierce reaction occurs between the red light and the contamination, making Bianca moan in pain. You struggle to get up and take a step back to keep your distance from her.

She doesn't follow you. Her unenhanced body has reached its limit. Bruises are spreading and burning every inch of her skin, climbing up her smiling face, yet her gradually weakening laughter tightens your heart more and more.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: ...Haha, you're right! I use the forbidden Mania in my self-indulgent investigations and executions. No matter how I glorify it, I must have hurt some innocent people. I'm a bad guy too, even worse than them!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: But I can't let those guys off, no matter what. I'm sick of seeing them escape punishment all the time. This world should be more black and white, and no one should be able to hide from their crimes. The bad guys must be accountable for their bad deeds.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: This is the real reason I invited you here, my partner in justice!

She staggers to her feet. Contamination carries her body toward you and Mania stretches her right arm out to you. You instinctively raise your hand to release the shackles, but suddenly... your hand is gently grasped.
Bianca holds your hand tremulously, letting the red light pierce through her own palm. The distant Mania mask roars furiously, but the journalist ignores it.
You look up to meet her gentle, mischievous eyes filled with smile.
You...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I'm so glad I met you, Ashy. Thank you for always steering clear of evil. Thank you for sweeping away all my confusion.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Once I have destroyed those bad guys, could you finish me off, for I have turned into a villain too?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Bad deeds should be punished. Someone in this world can still judge me. This is a world of justice. This is my dream...

The red light has dissolved some kind of invisible boundary. The distant clamor of the chaotic Purge has faded. The cocoon of Mania contamination around her gradually breaks down and fuses with your consciousness through the shackles. This time, it doesn't bring you pain, but... a deeper and more obscure emotion.
In a daze, you hear someone running endlessly and questioning indignantly. Anger, sadness, confusion, guilt, total incomprehension, and powerlessness. Everything washes over you before vanishing.

You regain consciousness and find Bianca gently resting her forehead on your shoulder, all the agony and grievance peeled off her mask. She smiles in such contentment and relief, still that cheerful, enthusiastic apple-cheeked girl who keeps running and never looks back.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I won't cast this vote. I won't judge Gray Mirror, and I won't judge you. I'm no different than you and them. None of us have the right to judge or sentence anyone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I will stop you on my own terms. I've promised you to end Mania here. I won't let it hurt anyone else, nor will I let it hurt you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But Bianca, I'm not doing all this for that broken dream of yours... I'm only following my own belief.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Haha, of course, you're right. Keep going and never give up. Because... I'm just as stubborn.
